title: Tenant-Safe Semantic Cache
signature: class SemanticCache: __init__(self, clock, log, capacity=100, threshold=0.9, ttl_s=3600.0), get(tenant, model, system_prompt, query) -> str or None, put(tenant, model, system_prompt, query, answer)
hints: The exact part of the key is (tenant, model, sha256(system_prompt)). Similarity is only ever compared inside one partition, so another tenant's entry can't be a candidate.
Purge expired entries at the start of every get and put. TTL counts from when the entry was stored, not from its last hit.
Keep a use counter that ticks on every store and every hit. The LRU victim has the smallest counter value, across the whole cache.
Log the events in the order the statement gives: expirations first, then the eviction, then the store or the hit/miss.
